name: GGL_launcher
description: 年糕122做的Minecraft啟動器，可以拿來玩GGL3的伺服器

scripts.build:rpc-helper: npm --prefix rpc-helper install --no-audit --no-fund && cd rpc-helper && npx --yes pkg index.js --targets node18-win-x64 --output ../assets/rpc-helper.exe
scripts.dist:win: npm run check:ui-css:strict && npm run docs:ipc && npm run build:css && npm run build:rpc-helper && node scripts/generate-electron-builder-config.cjs && electron-builder --config scripts/.electron-builder.generated.json --win nsis --x64 && npm run check:packaged-artifacts
scripts.pack:win: npm run check:ui-css:strict && npm run docs:ipc && npm run build:css && npm run build:rpc-helper && node scripts/generate-electron-builder-config.cjs && electron-builder --config scripts/.electron-builder.generated.json --win dir --x64 && npm run check:packaged-artifacts
scripts.format:ui: prettier --write styles.css index.html renderer.js main.js main/start-main.js main/launcher-log.js main/app-ready.js main/account-store.js main/paths.js main/settings.js main/notifications.js main/manifest-sync.js main/net-fetch.js main/microsoft-auth.js main/ipc-handlers.js main/ipc/index.js main/ipc/window-ipc.js main/ipc/external-ipc.js main/ipc/settings-ipc.js main/ipc/server-config-ipc.js main/ipc/dialog-ipc.js main/ipc/notifications-ipc.js main/ipc/instance-ipc.js main/ipc/diagnostics-ipc.js main/ipc/minecraft-ipc.js main/minecraft-bootstrap.js main/mc-mirror.js main/bundled-java.js main/minecraft-version-json.js main/minecraft-launch.js main/format-eta-seconds.js main/server-status.js main/main-window.js main/discord-rpc.js main/system-memory.js preload.js lib/settings-logic.js lib/ggl-structured-log.js lib/manifest-network.js lib/manifest-fields.js lib/discord-button-url.js lib/manifest-url-configured.js lib/manifest-file-url.js lib/paths-layout.js lib/server-config.js lib/discord-helper-args.js lib/notifications-broadcast.js lib/launcher-debug-logging.js renderer/constants.js renderer/ggl-log.js renderer/ui-status.js renderer/bootstrap-ctx.js renderer/bootstrap.js --ignore-unknown
